title: Noise stability
statement: For $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, its noise stability at correlation $\rho$ is the expectation of $f(x)f(y)$ when $(x,y)$ is drawn from the correlated pair distribution with parameter $\rho$.
